svg.text: Module C — Bonus Rolling & Rotating Attachments
Companion sheet to the core blueprint. All dimensions in millimetres. 1 drawing unit = 1 mm.
2 pen holes, r=50 & r=30, rim groove
free axle hole at outer end
seats in rim groove for grip
slot 240x8, pivot hole at inner end
Module C1 — Rolling Disc (draws a cycloid on the rail, a cardioid on the fixed disc)
Part B — Straight rail track (cycloid config)
Part C — Fixed disc + pivot arm (cardioid config)
SET-UP: glue a rubber O-ring into the rim groove of every disc, and matching grip on the rail/fixed disc, so nothing slips.
Cycloid: push the disc along the rail — one full lap of the rim hole per 314mm of travel (=2πr).
Cardioid: swing the pivot arm one full turn around the fixed disc. Use the r=30 hole for a loop-free curtate variant.
Module C2 — Spiral Arm (draws an Archimedean spiral, r = ρ·θ, via string on a fixed post)
SET-UP: tie the cord to the post, wind 2–3 turns, run it straight to the slider's eyelet and tie off.
r(θ) = ρ·θ (ρ = post radius = 8mm). One full turn of the arm adds 2π·ρ ≈ 50mm of radius.
Advanced upgrade: replace post+cord with an M6 threaded rod + a fixed sun-gear/pinion pair at the pivot for a literal leadscrew — same r=kθ result, more machining.
